sentences.text:
7. The trial arising out of FIR bearing no.0622/2017 was referred to Delhi Mediation Centre,
Karkardooma Courts, Delhi wherein the petitioner no.1 and the respondent no.2 have settled their disputes vide Settlement dated 25.02.2023 and have agreed to dissolve their marriage by decree of divorce by mutual consent as per section 13B of Hindu Marriage Act, 1955.

The petitioner no.1 has also agreed to pay Rs.11,00,000/- (Rupees Eleven Lacs Only) to the respondent no.2 towards the full and final settlement of all her claims/legal entitlements (past, present and future) arising out of their marriage including permanent alimony/maintenance/istridhan etc. and miscellaneous and legal expenses as per the schedule as mentioned in the Settlement.
The petitioner no.1 has already paid Rs. 6,50,000/- to the respondent no.2 which is acknowledged by the respondent no.2.

The counsel for the petitioner stated that the balance amount of Rs. 4,50,000/- shall be paid at the time of quashing of FIR bearing no.0622/2017 registered under sections 354/354A IPC at P.S. Kalyan Puri.

The petition bearing CRL.M.C.6731/2023 in respect of quashing of said FIR is listed before the court of Hon'ble Mr. Justice Vikas Mahajan on 17.10.2023.
8.

The marriage between the petitioner no.1 and the respondent no.2 has already been dissolved vide judgment dated 29.05.2023 in divorce petition bearing HMA no.1064/2023 titled as Ritu Khokher and Chiragdeep Malik @ Deepak passed by the Court of Sh. Naresh Kumar Malhotra,
